name: Zhejiang Laifual Drive Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Laifual Drive Co., Ltd., incorporated in 2013 and headquartered in Shengzhou, makes and sells precision transmission components for robots, such as harmonic reducers, joint modules and robotic arms, along with automated workstations. Customers work in robotics, medical imaging, semiconductors and machine tools. It sells in Europe, the United States, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong and China.
